title: Jeff Corwin: Southern Wild
description:
S01 E02 — Wildlife After Dark
Jeff joins Lees-McRae College students for a nighttime search for amphibians and reptiles at the Elk River Preserve; North Carolina Marine Fisheries; biologists study little brown bats and learn how to protect them from white-nose syndrome.
